### Day 245: Acts 13:42–52
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-245-acts-13-4252.html
Passage: Acts 13:42-52
Points:
- Spiritual breakthroughs and receptive crowds frequently provoke sudden opposition and jealousy.
- Opponents in Antioch leveraged prominent community leaders to organize persecution against the apostles.
- Satan often manipulates human social standing and authority to hinder gospel ministry.
- Every believer exerts ongoing influence over the people around them in daily life.
- Personal influence is a sacred trust that must be guarded and guided by the Holy Spirit.

### The Transfer of the Kingdom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-transfer-of-the-kingdom
Passage: Acts 13:46
Points:
- Paul and Barnabas consistently offered the gospel first to the Jewish synagogues.
- The rejection of the message by Jewish leaders led the apostles to turn to the Gentiles.
- This shift marked the redemptive transition of the kingdom reaching the wider world.
- Under the new covenant, all people stand on equal footing before God.
- Christians have a primary ministry obligation to nurture and serve the household of faith.
